notes.themes.colorScheme: This app keeps its theme only in sessionStorage for the tab, so a fresh browser context cannot preset it. The copied browser-check.mjs passes themes.<name>.colorScheme to the browser context, and the app follows prefers-color-scheme.
notes.colourRules: None: the app has no chart or banded value (app-plan.md, Colour semantics).
notes.confirmed route: /confirmed/:deliveryId and the read-only review need a receipt signed in this session, so they are covered by journey-check.mjs and build-journey.mjs, not here.
notes.server: Run against the production build served by node server.mjs (PORT=4320), not the dev server.
